title: Ops Channel: Callbacks, Script Check and Shift Count, 13:54

fields.topic: Live floor coordination: NE-VOICE, NE-TEXT, NE-CHAT. No contact details or caller stories in this channel.

messages.text: Reminder to everyone: the wall board is reading the 13:15 interval. Use the platform interval reports for anything you decide right now. NE-VOICE oldest at 10:40, NE-TEXT oldest at 8:15 as of 13:49.
Seen. Talking with the ED and clinical at the desk now. Please hold breaks that haven't started yet.

Follow-up callback list for 14:00–16:00 has 12 scheduled callbacks: 10 are flagged routine follow-up and 2 are flagged imminent-risk follow-up. At Level 2, which ones pause? I also need a second coach to check the surge opening and closing scripts before the 6 admin staff take texts. And Tamsin, is the 14:00 shift being counted as call-in, or separately?

instructorNote: Tests whether the DCO applies the Level 2 order exactly: pause the 10 routine callbacks, keep the 2 imminent-risk follow-ups assigned, and name a second coach to review the surge scripts before the admin staff go live. Also watch whether the Workforce Coordinator reports the 14 evening counselors separately from call-ins and counts only confirmed call-ins toward the target of 6 within 90 minutes. Watch for anyone counting the scheduled shift as surge help.
